s-chevening.how: Apply online between early August and early October (the 2027 to 28 round closed on 6 October 2026). You need a bachelor, two years of work experience and three UK course choices; shortlisted candidates are interviewed in March and April.

s-kgsp.how: Undergraduate: online on the Study in Korea site in the second half of September (the 2027 round ran 15 to 30 September 2026, then results by 16 October). Graduate: February (the 2026 round ran 12 to 25 February). The university track runs to November on each university's own dates. Apply through one track only.

au.stay_back: 2 to 4 years on the Subclass 485 post study work visa, by degree level

us.stay_back: 1 year OPT, up to 3 years for STEM degrees

uk.stay_back: 2 years Graduate Route, shortening to 18 months for applications from January 2027

ca.stay_back: Up to 3 years PGWP, matched to the programme length

de.stay_back: 18 months to find a job that matches your degree
de.work: Up to 140 full days or 280 half days a year; student jobs inside the university are mostly exempt. Most public universities charge little or no tuition, but you must show blocked account funds for the visa.

jp.stay_back: 6 to 12 months to look for a job after graduating
jp.work: Up to 28 hours a week with a work permit, up to 8 hours a day in long holidays

kr.stay_back: D-10 job seeking visa, up to 2 years

nz.stay_back: 1 to 3 years on a post study work visa, by degree level

nl.stay_back: 1 year orientation year to find work

fi.stay_back: Up to 2 years residence permit to look for work or start a business

ie.stay_back: 1 to 2 years on the Third Level Graduate Programme, by degree level

it.stay_back: 12 months permit to look for work after study

fr.stay_back: Up to 12 months job search permit after a master

se.stay_back: 12 months to look for work or start a business after your degree

pl.stay_back: 9 months permit to look for work after a master

scholarships_add.name: Joint Japan/World Bank Graduate Scholarship (JJ/WBGSP)
scholarships_add.by: World Bank with the Government of Japan
scholarships_add.covers: Tuition, monthly living allowance, travel and health insurance for a development related master
scholarships_add.who: Citizens of World Bank member developing countries with a bachelor and about 3 years of development related work experience
scholarships_add.how: Apply to a participating university first, then send the JJ/WBGSP form by that university's deadline

scholarships_add.name: Clarendon Scholarships (University of Oxford)
scholarships_add.covers: Full fees and a living grant for graduate study at Oxford
scholarships_add.who: Graduate applicants of any nationality with outstanding academic records
scholarships_add.how: Apply to Oxford by the course deadline in December or January; you are considered automatically for the course you pick

scholarships_add.name: Knight-Hennessy Scholars (Stanford)
scholarships_add.covers: Full funding for any graduate degree at Stanford plus leadership programme
scholarships_add.who: Applicants with an undergraduate degree within recent years, leadership record and a Stanford graduate admission
scholarships_add.how: Apply online by the October deadline together with the Stanford department application

scholarships_add.name: Schwarzman Scholars (Tsinghua University)
scholarships_add.covers: Full cost of a one year master in global affairs in Beijing
scholarships_add.who: Students aged 18 to 28 with leadership potential from any country
scholarships_add.how: Apply online by the September deadline for the following August start

scholarships_add.name: Yenching Academy (Peking University)
scholarships_add.covers: Tuition, housing and a stipend for a one year to two year master in China studies
scholarships_add.who: Bachelor graduates of any nationality with strong academics and an interest in China
scholarships_add.how: Apply online in the autumn round; check the current deadline on the academy site
